mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, OWNER_ID, TITLE, STATUS, VISIBILITY, MAX_MEMBERS FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT STATUS, BANNED_YN FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM JOIN_CODE_ATTEMPT A JOIN GYE_GROUP G ON G.GROUP_ID = A.GROUP_ID WHERE A.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND A.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND A.VERIFIED_YN = 'Y' AND A.FAIL_COUNT < 3 AND A.CODE_VERSION = G.JOIN_CODE_VERSION AND G.VISIBILITY = 'PRIVATE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JOIN_REQUEST ( JOIN_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, VIA, CODE_VERIFIED_YN, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{joinRequestId}, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{via}, #{codeVerifiedYn}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, OWNER_ID FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId}

SELECT JR.JOIN_REQUEST_ID AS "joinRequestId", JR.GROUP_ID AS "groupId", JR.MEMBER_ID AS "memberId", M.NAME AS "memberName", JR.VIA AS "via", JR.STATUS AS "status", JR.CREATED_AT AS "createdAt" FROM JOIN_REQUEST JR LEFT JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = JR.MEMBER_ID WHERE JR.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND JR.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND JR.CREATED_AT > SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY JR.CREATED_AT ASC, JR.JOIN_REQUEST_ID ASC

SELECT JOIN_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, STATUS, VIA, CODE_VERIFIED_YN, CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN STATUS = 'EXPIRED' OR ( STATUS = 'PENDING' AND CREATED_AT <= SYSDATE - 7 ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXPIRED_YN FROM JOIN_REQUEST WHERE JOIN_REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId}
mapper.update: UPDATE JOIN_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', DECIDED_BY = #{ownerId}, DECIDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE JOIN_REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND CREATED_AT > SYSDATE - 7
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GYE_MEMBER ( GYE_MEMBER_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_GYE_MEMBER.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE JOIN_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', DECIDED_BY = #{ownerId}, DECIDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE JOIN_REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND CREATED_AT > SYSDATE - 7
mapper.select: SELECT JOIN_REQUEST_ID FROM JOIN_REQUEST WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' AND CREATED_AT <= SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, JOIN_REQUEST_ID ASC

SELECT JR.JOIN_REQUEST_ID, JR.GROUP_ID, JR.MEMBER_ID, G.TITLE FROM JOIN_REQUEST JR JOIN GYE_GROUP G ON G.GROUP_ID = JR.GROUP_ID WHERE JR.JOIN_REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND JR.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND JR.CREATED_AT <= SYSDATE - 7
mapper.update: UPDATE JOIN_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'EXPIRED', DECIDED_BY = NULL, DECIDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE JOIN_REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND CREATED_AT <= SYSDATE - 7
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AUDIT_LOG ( AUDIT_LOG_ID, GROUP_ID, ACTOR_MEMBER_ID, ACTOR_ADMIN_ID, TARGET_MEMBER_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_AUDIT_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{actorMemberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NULL, #{targetMemberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{eventType}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE GYE_GROUP SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', STARTED_AT = NVL(STARTED_AT, SYSDATE), UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'RECRUITING'
mapper.select: SELECT JOIN_REQUEST_ID, MEMBER_ID FROM JOIN_REQUEST WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC, JOIN_REQUEST_ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE JOIN_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', DECIDED_BY = #{decidedBy, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, DECIDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
